description: Camera specifications for autocalibration. Pixel sizes from sensor datasheets.
notes: sensor_pixel_size_um is the physical pixel pitch on the sensor die. Effective pixel size depends on resolution (binning) and objective magnification.

ZYLA-4.2P.name: Andor Zyla 4.2P (USB3)
ZYLA-4.2P.notes: ANDOR ZYLA-4.2P-USB3-2V3 sCMOS, 6.5 um pixel, mono 16-bit. Preview resolutions are on-sensor binning presets (2x2/4x4/8x8/1x1). BINNED 1024x1024 is listed FIRST on purpose: it is the default live-preview mode — full 2048x2048 (1x1) is heavy for a live feed (large frames + ~840MB ring buffer). Driven via Andor SDK3 (pylablib); see gui/widgets/andor_backend.py.
